summary: Busy residential kerb where cars park; homes and flats close on both sides.
reasons: Flats 11-14 m away on south side
Flats and houses across the road too

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing and apartment blocks within about 11-16 m on the south side and close across the road; none within 10 m of this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain public street with parked cars along the kerb, so there is room to park in line.
drivers.traffic: Through street linking to a roundabout; steady traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van would blend in, but residents are close.

flags: Low-lying: about 3.9 m elevation, Toowong Creek 30 m away
Flats at 163 m sit 11 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees shade the north side and the first part of the stretch.

best_section.where: Alpha Street near the eastern end, between the flat blocks and the junction
